rationale: Correct the existing Bullrock record to the separate Apollo–Bullrock community-solar joint venture and portfolio vehicle. Apollo and Bullrock formed an equity joint venture in April 2025, but the transaction sources do not establish that Apollo acquired equity in the Bullrock Energy Ventures corporate parent. Current July 2026 FINRA disclosures identify AP Bullrock Holdings and Delphi Bullrock Energy Ventures LLC as Apollo-affiliated portfolio companies, corroborating active status. Preserve Bullrock as the developer and operating partner, qualify all undisclosed ownership facts, and remove Bullrock-platform milestones and profile claims that do not belong to the joint venture.

afterImage.name: Apollo–Bullrock Community Solar Joint Venture
afterImage.description: The Apollo–Bullrock Community Solar Joint Venture is a 2025 equity partnership formed by Apollo-managed funds and Bullrock Energy Ventures to invest in and develop a portfolio of community solar assets across New York and New England. Apollo committed up to $220 million in equity, including $100 million to support development of Bullrock's nearly 500 MW renewable-energy pipeline. Bullrock remains the separate developer and operating partner; reviewed sources do not establish that Apollo acquired an interest in the Bullrock corporate parent. Current July 2026 FINRA disclosures identify AP Bullrock Holdings and Delphi Bullrock Energy Ventures LLC as Apollo-affiliated portfolio companies, corroborating the joint venture's active status. The specific Apollo funds, deployed amount, ownership percentage, separate legal closing date and entity chain are not publicly disclosed. No sale or Apollo exit was identified through August 8, 2026.
